There is involvement of the applicant in the crime.
Considering the allegations against the applicant, his custodial interrogation is required and requested to reject the application.
5. It is contention of the learned counsel for respondent no.3 that the informant has received the amount from the applicant.
Respondent no.3 has filed affidavit stating that he has no objection to grant bail to the applicant.
6. I have heard both the learned counsel.
